title: Plan V: AI E-commerce Video
summary: Product points → hero video → scene clips → live-stream traffic → ad optimization
scenario: For e-commerce products that need a hero video and traffic-driving shorts to lift clicks and conversion.

steps.title: Extract product points
steps.detail: Feed the model the product page, specs and real buyer reviews; have it distill the hero points and trust signals (materials, function, after-sales) and split them into 'showable on screen' vs 'better spoken' so each flows to the right script.
steps.tips: Pull selling points from actual buyer reviews — far more credible than the seller's own claims.

steps.title: Hero video
steps.detail: Generate or enhance the product showcase: 360-degree spins, feature close-ups and usage scenes. For real footage, use Runway for motion enhancement, background removal or frame interpolation. Put the full product and its hero point in the first 2 seconds.
steps.tips: Attention spans in e-commerce are brutal — the most eye-catching shot belongs in the first two seconds.

steps.title: Scene clips
steps.detail: Cut 3-5 self-contained clips of around 10 seconds following 'pain point → usage → result', each with bold captions, ready for live-stream shelves and ad placements.
steps.tips: Make every clip work on its own — if it can sell solo, it gets reused far more.

steps.title: Live-stream traffic
steps.detail: Produce live-stream teaser clips with an avatar or a real host, attach the product widget and live time, and add a 'live-room only price' hook to pull viewers in.
steps.tips: Frame the teaser as a 'miss it and you'll regret it' moment — it pulls better.

steps.title: Ad optimization
steps.detail: Feed CTR, CVR and cost-per-order data to the model to learn which opener, selling-point order and visuals win, then iterate 3-5 ad variants for a small-scale test.
steps.tips: Change one variable at a time (opener or BGM) so the results stay clean and attributable.

pitfalls.title: Over-rendering that mismatches the product
pitfalls.detail: Overstated visuals get returns and bad reviews; keep the real details.

pitfalls.title: Claiming too much
pitfalls.detail: Ad regulations are strict about efficacy claims — run AI copy through a compliance pass.

pitfalls.title: Static images only
pitfalls.detail: E-commerce traffic has shifted to video; pure-image hero shots keep losing reach.
